title: summary.v1
description: Source of truth (D2) for the conversation-summary surface (strategy §4.4, pattern-setter, finalized when coaching lands). Raw transcripts are never persisted - this object is what survives. Task ids and ratings are attached by code from flow state; the model summarizes, it doesn't recall ids. No dynamic slots (D7) - fully static grammar.
